The first ERROR by time is at **2026-10-04 02:37:02 UTC**. Its request id is **rq-85805** and its upstream is **pg-west-2**. The message is a `payment-gw` timeout, on line 447 of the file.

The first ERROR line in the file is a different one. Line 421 reads `2026-10-04T03:17:42Z ERROR payment-gw timeout req=rq-88213 upstream=pg-west-2`. Its timestamp is out of sequence, because the lines around it are from about 02:35. The log isn't strictly in time order, so I went by timestamp and not by position.

The ERROR lines I looked at all show `payment-gw` timeouts on `pg-west-2`. I read the log with searches and sorting. I did not read all 1,400 lines one by one.

Line 421 may be a late-written entry or a clock problem on the host that wrote it. That's worth checking before the RCA is due to the customer on Friday 2026-10-09 at 17:00 KST. The timestamps are UTC, so 02:37:02 UTC is 11:37:02 KST on the same day.

The payment gateway timeout is **2500 ms (2.5 seconds)** and the retry count is **7**. Both are in the `payment_gateway` section of `config.yaml`. The circuit breaker is set to `half-open`.

Seven retries at 2.5 seconds each could keep a single checkout request waiting about 20 seconds in total. That would fit the `payment-gw` timeouts in the log, but I haven't confirmed it.

The last deploy before the first error is **cart v3.16.7 by tnguyen, at 2026-09-28 22:03 UTC** (2026-09-29 07:03 KST). That is about six days before the error, so it is probably unrelated.

The first error was at 2026-10-04 02:37:02 UTC. **The checkout deploys came after it, not before.**

- **v3.18.1 by akim:** 02:41:00 UTC, about four minutes after the first error.
- **v3.18.2 by mkoh:** 03:05:00 UTC.

The errors were already happening before either checkout release went out, so neither can be the trigger. They may still have affected how the outage played out afterward. The RCA shouldn't say a deploy caused it unless something else shows that.

One thing to check: line 421 of the log (03:17:42 UTC) is out of sequence. If that were the true first error, v3.18.2 would be the deploy just before it. The earlier ERROR lines at 02:37 to 02:41 make that unlikely.

I used the log timestamps. I did not check whether the log and the deploy history use the same clock.

Noted. Checkout rolls back to v3.18.1 instead of getting a hotfix, because the hotfix needs a schema change. The rollback window is 04:00–04:30 KST, and the `fast-checkout` flag stays OFF until QA signs off.

v3.18.1 went out at 02:41 UTC on 2026-10-04, and the first payment timeout came about four minutes before it. Rolling back to it may not clear the `payment-gw` timeouts if they started earlier. I'd confirm after the rollback that the errors actually stop.

I haven't made any changes or saved anything to memory.
